## Code Review

This pull request introduces a Hydra configuration and a shell script for fully asynchronous PPO training of the Qwen3-VL-30B model on NPU. The review feedback identifies several areas for improvement, including correcting an inconsistent experiment name, removing redundant configuration parameters in the shell script, addressing potential GPU allocation errors on 8-GPU nodes, and improving script portability by avoiding hardcoded absolute paths and fragile cross-directory dependencies.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The experiment name `qwen3_vl_3b_megatron_async_test` contains `3b`, but the model path and PR title indicate a `30B` model. This inconsistency can lead to confusion in experiment tracking and logging.

```suggestion
EXP_NAME='qwen3_vl_30b_megatron_async_test'
```
